finalText:
**Redis died at 02:14:07 and the service never recovered.** It went down 17 minutes later.

Timeline:

| Time | Event |
|---|---|
| 02:14:07 | `redis connection lost: ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379` |
| 02:14:07 | Cache falls back to direct store reads |
| 02:14:10 | First `TimeoutError` after 5000ms |
| 02:29:12 | Queue depth passes the 500 max |
| 02:31:44 | `worker-2` JavaScript heap out of memory |
| 02:31:52 | `supervisor` kills process group, service down |

Redis never came back. All 13 reconnect attempts got `ECONNREFUSED` on the same host. The 173 timeouts and 174 cache-miss storms are downstream noise, not causes.

Next: check why `10.0.0.12` refused connections.
